component.name: CodeLo
component.summary: Local coding sessions for classrooms and assessments

description.p: CodeLo is a local classroom coding platform designed for teachers, instructors, and educators who want to host programming sessions for students.
CodeLo supports predefined code templates and reference materials, allowing educators to provide students with the required resources for assignments and assessments.
CodeLo includes built-in support for Safe Exam Browser (SEB), helping educators create secure environments for programming examinations.
